product.title: Acadia Half Day Private Bike Tour

description.text: Ride Acadia National Park’s historic carriage roads on a private bike outing with bikes and helmets provided, van support, and a naturalist-style guide. The half-day format keeps the group private so pacing and stops can match your riders—including options for regular bikes or e-bikes when available. Stops include Carriage Roads, Eagle Lake, Jordan Pond. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on coastal overlooks, carriage roads, and photography or adventure highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Bar Harbor who want a guided Acadia National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or carriage roads on their own.
